item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 6 #SLPRSD
item.description:

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Sorsogon(Castilla, Donsol, Pilar, CityOfSorsogon), #Masbate(Monreal, SanJacinto, SanFernando, SanPascual, Claveria, Balud, Mandaon, Batuan, Baleno, Aroroy, CityOfMasbate, Mobo, Uson, Dimasalang), #NorthernSamar(SanIsidro, Victoria, Rosario, SanJose), #Marinduque(Buenavista, Mogpog, Gasan, Boac), #Catanduanes(Caramoran, SanAndres, Pandan, Virac), #Albay(LegazpiCity, Manito, Bacacay, SantoDomingo, RapuRapu, Malilipot, CityOfTabaco, Malinao, Tiwi, Daraga, Camalig, Jovellar, PioDuran, Guinobatan, CityOfLigao, Oas, Polangui), #CamarinesSur(Sagñay, SanJose, Presentacion, Caramoan, Siruma, Tinambac, Lagonoy, Garchitorena, Goa, Tigaon, Buhi), #OrientalMindoro(Victoria, Pola, Socorro, Pinamalayan, Naujan, Gloria), #Romblon(Romblon, Concepcion, Banton, Corcuera, Calatrava, SanAndres, SanAgustin, Magdiwang, Cajidiocan and SanFernando) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Sorsogon(Barcelona, Bulan, Bulusan, Casiguran, Gubat, Irosin, Juban, Magallanes, Matnog, PrietoDiaz, SantaMagdalena), #NorthernSamar(SanVicente, Capul, SanAntonio, Allen, Lavezares, Biri), #Marinduque(SantaCruz and Torrijos) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.
